description: 连续并发批量拓扑修改专项：1024 个 mixed triggerSource 在持续输入下，分组连续执行结构化批量 relink，观测运行期大批量拓扑替换成本。

steps.name: mutate_round1_sync_banded32
steps.commandTemplate: redstonelink bench link apply triggerSource {{source:sync_p25_group:range}} core {{targets:range}} banded fanout=32 stride=32 offset=0 wrap=true

steps.name: mutate_round1_pulse_banded32
steps.commandTemplate: redstonelink bench link apply triggerSource {{source:pulse_p25_group:range}} core {{targets:range}} banded fanout=32 stride=32 offset=7 wrap=true

steps.name: mutate_round1_toggle_banded32
steps.commandTemplate: redstonelink bench link apply triggerSource {{source:toggle_p25_group:range}} core {{targets:range}} banded fanout=32 stride=32 offset=15 wrap=true

steps.name: mutate_round2_pulse_fan_in_first

steps.name: mutate_round2_toggle_fan_in_first
